items.statement: Two doses of 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection) administered on Day 1 and Day 29

Dosing Schedule: Two doses (Day 1 and Day 29)
Dose: 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection)

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P301
items.statement: COVID-19 ≥14 days post-dose 2: 94.3% vaccine efficacy (95% CI: 91.3%, 95.3%), p-value < 0.0001; 17 cases in vaccine group vs 182 cases in placebo group (n=15,210 each)

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P301
items.statement: Severe COVID-19: 98.4% vaccine efficacy, p-value < 0.0001; 1 case in vaccine group vs 26 cases in placebo group (n=15,210 each)

items.subject: mRNA-1273
items.statement: Injection site pain (90%), fatigue (67%), headache (60%), and myalgia (56%); majority were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days
items.supporting_quote: The most common solicited adverse events were injection site pain (90%), fatigue (67%), headache (60%), and myalgia (56%). The majority of adverse events were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days.

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P301
items.statement: Seroconversion rate of 99.2% at 28 days post-dose 2 with geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 of 1699 (95% CI: 834 – 2335)
items.supporting_quote: Geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 were 1699 (95% CI: 834 – 2335). Seroconversion rates were 99.2% at 28 days post-dose 2.
